properties.name: Malvan Marine Sanctuary
properties.description: Core marine sanctuary protecting coral reefs, mangrove estuaries, and sea turtles. All mechanized and commercial fishing strictly prohibited. Violation leads to vessel impoundment.
properties.authority: Maharashtra Forest Department (Wildlife Wing) & Coast Guard

properties.name: Jaigad Commercial Port Navigational Fairway
properties.description: Deep-water approach channel for LNG tankers and bulk cargo carriers. Laying gillnets, purse-seines, or anchoring inside fairway is hazardous and prohibited.
properties.authority: Maharashtra Maritime Board & Jaigad Port Control
